blurb: Guests join fishing charters on Lake Ontario and Sodus Bay to catch various fish species including Trout, Salmon, Brown Trout, King Salmon, Rainbow, Steelhead, and Coho. Trips include full-day and half-day options with all fishing gear provided. Captain Ray Hopping is a U.S.C.G. licensed captain with over 24 years of Great Lakes fishing experience.
